public_summary: An integration-friendly electronic album for builders, operators, and long technical sessions.
release_notes: The release is published and the live network links are populated for the approved services.
The public page and local dossier are kept in sync.
The GitHub Pages repo carries the playable audio bundle under audio/ with the 11 WAV masters plus the playlist beside it.
The GitHub Pages repo also carries developer kits for JavaScript, Python, Go, PowerShell, and CSS integrations.
An archive handoff manifest is staged in archive-package.md.
The staged upload bundle now includes the playlist, audio masters, and cover art.
Primary album links are live on Spotify, Tidal, Apple Music, and Amazon Music.
The companion single Pasha x Brain Like Prada is live on Spotify, YouTube Music, Tidal, Apple Music, and Amazon Music.
Full #Zupreme Spotify catalog is folded into this site: Music to Win By plus Chicago on Beatties Ford, Gimme The Prompt x Drop a Pin, and Pasha x Brain Like Prada.
Normalize the artist family as Zupreme / #ZUPREME / #704Vex while reconciling Apple Music, TIDAL, YouTube, and YouTube Music.
Recent YouTube music shorts are playable on the Audio Frame music page and mirrored into Signal Lab.

notes: The staged media bundle now includes the playlist, audio masters, and cover art.
Keep outbound links blank until they are verified and live.
Mirror the same title, track order, and release language in every public host.
